Choose Lite if
You have strong mechanics but lose to smokes and missing loot. You want the lowest-complexity entry to fortnite cheats. You stream occasionally and prefer minimal automation footprint.
Lite gives player ESP, drop locator, loot timers, radar hack, and stream-safe overlay—no Aimbot. Supports and rotators who win through vision often never need Pro.
Choose Pro if
You play Ranked or instances daily on close-range loadouts—ARs, SMGs, and snipers. You want Aimbot, Smooth Aim, Sticky Aim, Bone Priority, and Hotkey macros for heal and mobility timing.

Pro includes every Lite module plus aimbot—see the full list in our [features guide](/blog/fortnite-cheats-features-guide/). Aim duelists climbing rank on combo players see the fastest return from Pro.
Module comparison
Lite: player ESP, chest and reboot-van locator, loot spawn timers, radar hack, team color filter, stream-proof overlay.

Pro adds: Aimbot, Smooth Aim, Sticky Aim, Bone Priority, Hotkey macros, Auto Heal, FOV and smoothness drawing, and 18+ more modules in the portal. You never lose Lite features when upgrading—Pro is additive.
ranked and instances fit

Supports and rotators often thrive on Lite—vision wins fights without script risk. DPS and support players on combo classes benefit from Pro aimbot tuned in our [ranked play guide](/blog/fortnite-aimbot-ranked-guide/).
Instances' fast pace rewards Pro Hotkey macros more than Lite alone—fights chain faster and manual heal timing slips. Start Lite in instances if new; upgrade when ESP feels natural.
EAC and report considerations

Lite carries lower report surface—no instant combo bursts that look robotic in replays. Pro requires conservative Smoothness sliders from day one. Both tiers need [EAC patch day checklist](/blog/eac-patch-day-checklist/) after updates.
Neither tier is EAC-proof—read fnhacks.org status before every session. Humanized settings beat max automation for account longevity.
